blocks.text: Locations identify the various networks from which your organization sends its cloud traffic. When you deploy Zscaler Cloud Connector or Zscaler Branch Connector, the Zscaler service automatically creates a location using a location template with defined attributes.
Locations provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Identify the locations and sublocations from which your organization sends its workload traffic.
Apply forwarding and security policies to workload traffic.
Configure various settings such as Firewall Control, Acceptable Usage Policy (AUP), Caution, Authentication, and XFF Forwarding.
Enforce Bandwidth Control and specify the maxiumum bandwidth limits for download and upload.

blocks.text: On the Locations page (Infrastructure >Location Management > Locations > Cloud tab), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Search for a location or sublocations.

blocks.text: When you click the number in the Sublocations column, the View Sublocation window appears. You can configure sublocations in the Zscaler Admin Console. To learn more, see Understanding Sublocations and Configuring Sublocations.

blocks.item: Add a location. To learn more, see Configuring a Cloud Provisioning Template.
View a list of all locations, the scope type (if configured), and the number of associated sublocations.
Select a location name to view details and edit a location.
View information about all types of locations.
